verdict.rationale: incident.io documents declaring and running incidents from Slack or Microsoft Teams, auto-starting a Teams meeting per incident, GitHub PR updates in the incident channel, and follow-ups exported as GitHub Issues with changes synced back. A changelog entry adds two-way incident-ticket sync, where ticket changes update the incident and incident changes update the ticket, and Asana action sync is also documented. Missing for 10: Jira not explicitly named as the ticket-sync target, no evidence of a Zoom integration, no independent or hands-on corroboration of two-way sync.
